{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
df_clean = df[df['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Print final result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers: {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Return the value
mean_revenue"}
